changelog.title: Initial Release!
items: First public release of Production Calculator.
Products, Recipes, Machines, Modifiers, and Attributes are supported.
Users are able to create workflows, alias projects, and define project models.

futurePlans.title: Belt Model
futurePlans.description: Automatically calculate the required belt types and counts based on throughput.
